cv.name: Ciarán Kiely
cv.headline: Newly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ACA) – Audit & Financial Reporting
cv.summary: Chartered accountant who qualified in 2025 after a three-year training contract in audit. Experienced with statutory audits of Irish SMEs and subsidiaries reporting under FRS 102 and IFRS, now looking for an industry accounting role.

experience.title: Audit Senior (Newly Qualified)
bullets: Run fieldwork for statutory audits of manufacturing and agri-food clients
Prepare financial statements under FRS 102 and review junior staff work
Supervise teams of two to three trainees on site

experience.title: Trainee Accountant (ACA)
bullets: Performed audit testing on revenue, payroll and fixed assets
Prepared year-end corporation tax computations for small companies
